"""Paint the frozen Vermeer reference using separate, straight brush sweeps.
Run from /app/output; planner.py and search.so select sweeps against current canvas.
"""
import os,time,json,numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_brush import Session
from planner import choose,SCALE,width_depth
OUT='/app/output'; s=Session(instance='/app/instance.json',render=False);p=s.primitives();m=p['move_tip'];s.record_start();plan=[]
loaded=-1

def dip(ci):
 global loaded
 xy=s.wells()[ci]['center_xy']
 m([*xy,.052],speed=.25,settle=2)
 m([*xy,.024],speed=.09,settle=3)
 m([*xy,.05],speed=.10,settle=2)
 loaded=ci

def stroke(x1,y1,x2,y2,depth,ci):
 global loaded
 if ci!=loaded:dip(ci)
 a=s.geo.mm_to_world(x1,y1);b=s.geo.mm_to_world(x2,y2)
 m([*a,.038],speed=.22,settle=3)
 m([*a,.020-depth/1000],speed=.05,settle=4)
 m([*b,.020-depth/1000],speed=.04,settle=4)
 m([*b,.038],speed=.075,settle=3)
 plan.append([x1,y1,x2,y2,depth,int(ci)])

def checkpoint(tag):
 im=s.canvas();Image.fromarray(im).save(f'{OUT}/canvas{tag}.png')
 s.save_trajectory(np.asarray(s._since_reset),f'{OUT}/trajectory.npz')
 json.dump(plan,open(f'{OUT}/plan.json','w'))
 print('CHECK',tag,'steps',s.n_steps,'elapsed',round(time.time()-t0),flush=True)

t0=time.time()
# Opaque, broad ground: each is one lifted straight sweep.
for i,x in enumerate(np.linspace(3,224,33)):
 stroke(x,2,x,225,8,14)
checkpoint('_ground')
for it in range(417):
 best,gain,err=choose(s.canvas(),it)
 x,y,ang,l,w,ci=best
 dx=np.cos(ang)*l/2;dy=np.sin(ang)*l/2
 dep=width_depth(w*SCALE)
 stroke((x-dx)*SCALE,(y-dy)*SCALE,(x+dx)*SCALE,(y+dy)*SCALE,dep,int(ci))
 print('stroke',len(plan),'err',round(err,3),'gain',round(gain),'params',np.round(plan[-1],2).tolist(),flush=True)
 if (it+1)%25==0:checkpoint(f'_{len(plan):03d}')
checkpoint('_final')
a=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(a,f'{OUT}/trajectory.npz')
print('STATE',s.state_sha(),flush=True)
print('SCORE',s.score(),flush=True)
